# Lake Stevens AFH LLC

> A state-licensed adult family home (AFH) in Lake Stevens, Washington, providing 24/7 personalized senior care for a maximum of 4 residents. Serving Lake Stevens, Everett, Marysville, Snohomish, Machias, Monroe, Arlington, Bothell, and Snohomish County, WA.

Lake Stevens AFH LLC is a licensed residential care home operating in a private house rather than an institutional facility. Licensed and regulated by the Washington State Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS), Adult Family Home License No. 759247. Owner and primary caregiver: Zinash Shibeshe. Established 2025. Address: 11921 24th PL NE, Lake Stevens, WA 98258. Phone: (206) 383-3109.

## Key Facts
- Type: Adult Family Home (AFH), a licensed residential care home distinct from assisted living facilities and nursing homes
- Capacity: 4 residents maximum (licensed capacity)
- Staffing: On-site caregivers awake and present 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; caregiver-to-resident ratio never worse than 1:4
- Services: Dementia and memory care, daily living assistance (bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility), medication management, nutritious home-cooked meals
- Payment: Primarily private-pay; some long-term care insurance policies cover AFH costs; Medicaid via Washington's ALTSA program may cover qualifying residents
- Regulator: Washington State DSHS (Adult Family Home licensing program), License No. 759247
- Service area: Lake Stevens, Everett, Marysville, Snohomish, Machias, Monroe, Arlington, Bothell, and Snohomish County, WA
